description: This file defines a helper class `LocalNotifications` for managing local push notifications in a Flutter app. It handles initializing notifications for Android and iOS, creating notification channels/categories, requesting permissions, and showing notifications with action buttons for saved news articles. It also processes notification responses to navigate or undo saved articles, integrating with app navigation and state management.

classes.name: LocalNotifications.ShowResult
classes.description: A simple class representing the result of attempting to show a notification, indicating success and providing diagnostics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes notifications for Android and iOS, sets up channels/categories, requests permissions, and maintains internal state.

methods.name: showSavedArticleNotification
methods.description: Displays a local notification indicating an article was saved, with actions to open or undo saving the article.

methods.name: _toPayloadJson
methods.description: Converts a NewsArticle object into a JSON payload for notifications.

methods.name: _articleFromPayload
methods.description: Parses a JSON payload back into a NewsArticle object.

methods.name: _handleAction
methods.description: Processes notification action responses, navigating or undoing save actions based on the action ID.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveNotificationResponse
methods.description: Callback for handling notification responses on foreground.

methods.name: _onDidReceiveBackgroundNotificationResponse
methods.description: Callback for handling notification responses in background isolate, attempting to handle actions like undo or navigation.
